RESET_LEGACY_20_DEG_GATE.symptom: reset exceeds 20 degree envelope; no motion
RESET_LEGACY_20_DEG_GATE.classification: pre-planner configuration gate, not cuRobo failure
RESET_LEGACY_20_DEG_GATE.resolution: separate reset envelope and native reset mode

TRACKING_ERROR.symptom: native execution stopped after following error exceeded 0.2 degree
TRACKING_ERROR.automatic_action: only after abort, servo-off and logout all return zero: read fresh state, replan remaining reset with cuRobo at 2x, retry once
never_automatic: resume after collision, limit, E-stop, tool change, communication failure or unconfirmed cleanup

AUTO_RECOVERY_WORKSPACE_BLOCKED.symptom: 2x recovery replan rejected by right workspace separation
AUTO_RECOVERY_WORKSPACE_BLOCKED.classification: fresh start/path enters unmodeled shared-arm region
AUTO_RECOVERY_WORKSPACE_BLOCKED.resolution_required: park/read the left arm and commission a dual-arm collision scene; do not silently relax Y separation
